correctness.rationale: For prime power q≥2, rank-four spherical building is a two-dimensional simply connected wedge of q^6 two-spheres by Solomon–Tits. Projective Singer G=C_{(q+1)(q²+1)} acts without simplex inversions. Its only nonidentity vertex stabilizers are H=F_{q²}^×/F_q^× (order q+1) on q²+1 middle-dimension subspaces; other elements have no fixed geometric point. Armstrong gives π1(Y)=G/H=C_{q²+1}, hence H1 cyclic same order. Burnside fixed-cell Euler gives χ(Y)=(1+q^6+q(q²+1))/((q+1)(q²+1))=q³−q²+1. The two-dimensional quotient cellular C2 is free, so H2 is free of rank χ−1=q²(q−1); UCT gives H²=Z^{q²(q−1)}⊕C_{q²+1}, higher H=0. The argument includes nonprime powers. Finite independently recomputed q=2,3,4,5,7 Euler and group orders corroborate but do not establish all prime powers.
